title: How immersion lithography saved Moore’s Law

passages.note: Early prototype account and Controlling the pesky puddle. ASML identifies the autumn 2003 AT:1150i prototype result and the December 2003 XT:1250i announcement, and says that TSMC’s 2004 functional 90 nm chips were made with early ASML immersion equipment. The participant account describes parallel technical contributions from ZEISS and Philips Research.

lineage: ASML retrospective with interviews of its participating engineers.
